mapper.select: SELECT m.loan_maturity_overdue_id, m.applied_base_rate, m.applied_additional_rate, la.loan_principal_balance FROM loan_maturity_overdue m JOIN loan_account la ON la.loan_account_id = m.loan_account_id WHERE m.loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM maturity_overdue_daily_charge WHERE loan_maturity_overdue_id = #{loanMaturityOverdueId} AND charge_date = #{chargeDate})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maturity_overdue_daily_charge (loan_maturity_overdue_id, charge_date, loan_judgment_status_id, delinquency_target_amount, delinquency_rate, delinquency_charge, delinquency_status_id) VALUES (#{loanMaturityOverdueId}, #{chargeDate}, #{loanJudgmentStatusId}, #{delinquencyTargetAmount}, #{delinquencyRate}, #{delinquencyCharge}, #{delinquencyStatusId})
